commands: '=== web-04 sites/bindings matching logon2 or preview2-logon ==='

$hit=$false; Get-Website | ForEach-Object { $s=$_; $s.Bindings.Collection | ForEach-Object { if ($_.bindingInformation -match 'logon2') { $hit=$true; "$($s.Name) | $($_.protocol) | $($_.bindingInformation)" } } }; if (-not $hit) { 'NO binding mentions logon2 on web-04' }
